title: fix: GDPR Art.5 — remove email PII from UserCreated/UserUpdated audit logs
body: ### SUMMARY ## Compliance Fix **Regulation:** GDPR Art.5 (data minimisation), Art.25 (privacy by design) **Issue:** GDPR Art.5 — Full user email written to persistent audit logs in UserApi events ## What Changed Removed `item.email` from the audit event payloads in `SupersetUserApi.post_add` (UserCreated) and `post_update` (UserUpdated) in `superset/security/manager.py`. ## Why This is a Compliance Violation GDPR Art.5 requires that only strictly necessary personal data is collected and stored. Email addresses are PII and were being persisted to the permanent audit trail (DBEventLogger/S3EventLogger) without necessity — `username` and `user_id` are sufficient for audit identification. `post_delete` already omitted email, making this an inconsistency. ## Test Added `tests/unit_tests/security/audit_log_test.py` — added `test_user_api_post_add_excludes_email` and `test_user_api_post_update_excludes_email` which assert that `"email"` is not present in the audit payload. Existing tests updated to match the new payload shape. ### BEFORE/AFTER SCREENSHOTS OR ANIMATED GIF N/A — backend-only change, no UI impact. ### TESTING INSTRUCTIONS 1. Run `pytest tests/unit_tests/security/audit_log_test.py -v --noconftest` 2. Verify all 16 tests pass, including the two new GDPR-specific assertions. ### ADDITIONAL INFORMATION - [x] Has associated issue: - [ ] Required feature flags: - [ ] Changes UI - [ ] Includes DB Migration - [ ] Introduces new feature or API - [ ] Removes existing feature or API Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/6c58da37d9a540109e7a180ce558863e ---
